notes.title: Seed of Agony gameplay demo Live!
notes.content:
Hi folks, Matt Cohen here. I can't wait to take you through the opening couple of hours of my game, Seed of Agony! If you like retro games, you MUST give this a look. Imagine getting to play your favorite old game, be it Mega Man, Metroid, Castlevania, and have the feel of that game projected forever into an infinitely generating 2D galaxy with dozens of different level types. It's not all just one type of random generation forever! Seed of Agony is specifically designed to create organic platforming levels of various types. Hand-crafted levels are also littered throughout, to give it that special tough. You never know what you're going to get, and every level is a surprise.

This is a game for anyone who likes retro games but wish that instead of playing Mega Man 3 for the 435th time, they could play an unending version of it that only gets more and more interesting the longer  they play. Seed of Agony is all that and much more! Take a gander, won't you?

notes.title: Seed of Agony live
notes.content: Autonomic Interactive's Creative Director, Matt Cohen, will be playing AI's new retro action RPG, Seed of Agony. In this game, player's take control of a living demon ship and its inhabitants, an army of expendable demons. The ship's task is to drift through a nascent galaxy, conquering planets and colonizing them in the name of the demon Emperor.
